title: Refund policy
text: Monthly subscriptions can be refunded within 30 days of the original purchase. Customers request a refund by emailing billing@example.test with the workspace ID and invoice number. Renewal charges are eligible only when the request arrives within 7 days of renewal.

title: Single sign-on setup
text: SAML single sign-on is available on the Enterprise plan. An organization owner enables SSO under Settings, Security, then Single sign-on. The identity provider metadata URL and verified company domain are required before activation.

title: Data retention
text: Application logs are retained for 90 days on the Standard plan and 365 days on the Enterprise plan. Deleted workspace content enters a 14-day recovery window before permanent deletion. Audit-log retention can be extended by contract.

title: Incident severity and response
text: A Severity 1 incident is a complete production outage or confirmed data exposure affecting multiple customers. The on-call engineer acknowledges Severity 1 incidents within 15 minutes and posts customer updates every 30 minutes until mitigation.

title: API rate limits
text: The public API allows 600 requests per minute per workspace. Responses include the X-RateLimit-Remaining header. When the limit is exceeded, the service returns HTTP 429 and clients should retry with exponential backoff.

title: Workspace data export
text: Organization owners can start a full workspace export from Settings, Data, then Export. The export is delivered as a ZIP file through a signed link that expires after 24 hours. Large exports can take up to 6 hours to prepare.

title: Roles and permissions
text: Members can view and edit project content but cannot manage billing or security settings. Admins manage members and integrations. Only organization owners can change billing, delete a workspace, configure SSO, or start a full data export.

title: Billing cycle
text: Paid plans can be billed monthly or annually. Annual billing includes a 15 percent discount compared with twelve monthly payments. Plan downgrades take effect at the end of the current billing period.

title: Backups and recovery
text: Encrypted database backups run every 6 hours and are stored in a separate region. Daily backups are retained for 35 days. Recovery exercises are performed quarterly and the recovery point objective is 6 hours.

title: Support coverage
text: Standard support operates Monday through Friday from 09:00 to 18:00 Central European Time. Enterprise customers receive 24/7 support for Severity 1 incidents. The target first response for standard-priority tickets is one business day.

title: Attachment upload guide A
text: The maximum attachment upload size is 25 MB.

title: Attachment upload guide B
text: The maximum attachment upload size is 100 MB.
